A '''hypermatter reactor igniter'''&mdash;or '''HMRI'''&mdash;was a key component in a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], without which, initiating the jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] was impossible. Once installed, the HMRI needed to go through a warm-up cycle before coming online. Once online, however, the hyperdrive could engage automatically.
